name: @feldspar/react-native
title: React Native (web, Android, iOS)
description: Build an application's UI with React Native components: rendered in the browser by react-native-web, and built into Android and iOS apps from the same source, with the same scaffold, typed client and build.
supplies: An application framework, "React Native (web)": pick it when creating an application, and Saltcorn writes a React Native project for the web — Vite, react-native-web, a screen and typed hooks for every table the app exposes.
Native builds of the same project: an Android APK or AAB, and on a Mac an iOS simulator app or an IPA signed from a provisioning profile in the file store.
